assets.safety_notes: Legible amber pixel MT monogram at center; all 4 required badges legible (READ-ONLY, PAPER SANDBOX, AUTOTRADE OFF, AUDITED); no humans, no broker logos, no candles, no account/order numbers, no PnL, no secrets, no buy/sell/execute/order controls, no percentage/KPI dashboard.

Reviewed again in integration context on 2026-07-05 — see docs/showcase/media_integration_001.md for the in-context verdict.
